title: Page 344
transc:
No 2  9 P. m.
Caldwell Richmond  Wash May 17 1865
Rosetta lady yacht Madrid is here
with his wife & is sick
tulip It is not safe for
him to beat at Hotel &
he is reluctant to go into
a pot. family yard He would
go into your house for awhile
if agreeable to you ---- Will
you write him to do so 
while your family are absent Costume


230 PM

that Canby Spared from arno recollecting that the whinny
